fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-04-04 at approximately 00:45, it was reported that a parked car of the complainant was damaged near Iniyan Layout Parking Area in Namakkal, with a repair estimate of about Rs. 90,000. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Udhay Pandian (9000000220) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property allegedly damaged following a local dispute.
fields.Keywords: property damage, vandalism, night, parking area, witness
